## Type of Change
- [ ] feat: New feature
- [ ] fix: Bug fix
- [ ] refactor: Code refactor (no behavior change)
- [ ] docs: Documentation update
- [ ] chore: Project / config / asset adjustment
- [ ] style: Format only, no logic change

## Related Issue
<!-- Closes #xxx, leave blank if none -->

## Changes
<!-- Describe the changes in detail -->

## Breaking Changes
- [ ] No breaking changes
- [ ] Has breaking changes:
  <!-- Explain incompatible changes to API, data format, events or config -->

## Checklist
- [ ] Tested locally
- [ ] No debug prints or temporary comments left
- [ ] Docs / i18n updated if needed
- [ ] API calls and event signals work correctly
- [ ] Commit messages follow conventional commits
- [ ] No unnecessary binary files committed
- [ ] Version number updated as required
- [ ] Code follows project style rules
- [ ] Branch rebased on target branch before PR
